QuestInfo.0: 0 = #b#p2060005##k is performing further research about monster riding. I wonder if he's finished researching #t4031507#? Time to grab my swimming trunks and head back to Aqua Road!

QuestInfo.2:
#p2060005# handed you the #b#t2270000##k that can tame monsters. Talk to Kenta to go to the Area of Wild Hog and tame a hog.

0.0: Ah, you are the one who protected Oinkers from attackers! What good timing! Finally, I have the results of #t4031507#. When you train monsters, you shouldn't use #t4031507# as it is. When you use #t4031507# as it is, monsters can become violent. I need something to neutralize #t4031507#. I have an idea, but it will require a bit of a journey on your part...
0.1: Do you know the town of Leafre? The leader of that town, Chief Tatamo, sells a #bspecial perfume bottle#k. I've done research and apparently, if you put #t4031507# into the perfume bottle, you can calm monsters, making them much easier to train. The power of the bottle can remove the dangerous scent of #t4031507#. Can you get the bottle? Again, I will make it worth your while!

yes.0: Excellent! Then go to town of Leafre and get #b#t4031509##k. Leafre is on Ossyria, so it's a good distance from here. And just so you know...Tatamo's #t4031509# is precious, so you may need a pretty penny to convince him to part with it...

no.0: Are you sure? I know it's pricey but it's a one-time cost.

1.0: Wow! This is #t4031509#! Perfect. Now if I put this into #t4031507# which I gathered before... Done! This will train monsters: #b#t2270000##k!

yes.0: I'll send you to where the Tamable Hog is if you talk to me later. It'd be cool to see your tamed monster the next time you're in Aquarium!
yes.1: This technique will help people accept the idea of peaceful co-existence with monsters. More people can live with monsters thanks to this, can't they? It was worth it! I can't thank you enough!

item.0: Haven't you got #b#t4031509##k yet? It's expensive, but I need it. Come back when you have it!
